fields.Name: T170 - Human Review Queue History Toggle
fields.Description: Exercises the review CurrentView queue↔history toggle (SetView) — a distinct in-tab view-mode switch not covered by generic view toggles.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher next to the logo, choose "Testing", then click the "Review" tab. Near the top there is a view toggle with "Review Queue" and "History" buttons. Click "History" and verify the content switches to the reviewed/history view, then click "Review Queue" to switch back. Success is that the toggle swaps the two views (each showing content or a valid empty state). Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Review tab shows a Review Queue / History view toggle
Clicking History switches to the history view; clicking Review Queue switches back
Each view renders its content or a valid empty state
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
